title: Chanvoy wait_dm_follow_v2 Parameters
description: Strict parameters for one process-held wait on a direct message by exact username. After direct-channel admission the existing wait_follow_v2.event stream is used. There is no team or channel selector.

username.description: Exact Mattermost username of the peer. Not a channel id, UUID, user id, or {uid}__{uid} DM name.

timeout_secs.description: Required positive u64 duration. The absolute deadline starts at RPC entry.

coalesce_ms.description: Required coalescing window in milliseconds. The first admitted message opens the window. The producer flushes by this deadline or at 32 messages, whichever comes first. Five seconds is the recommended operating value; ten seconds is the hard maximum.

mention.description: When true, only posts that mention this bot complete the wait. Logical AND with contains and pattern. Default false/absent. Non-matches are not tips.

after.description: Exclusive baseline post id on this DM conversation, not an inbox cursor.
